Priya Rao: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pages from transformer-postproc. I want a short action list so we can close RDW-4637.

Priya Rao: Root problem: duplicate pages from short lived spikes + different jobs reporting same fingerprint across regions. Proposed fixes below.

Diego Ramos: Can you paste the prod alert rule?

Priya Rao: Prod rule snippet:
```yaml
alert: TransformerPostprocErrors
expr: increase(transformer_postproc_errors_total[5m]) > 5
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-4637
```

Samir Patel: 30s `for` is too low. Suggest `for: 4m` and group by `job,error_fingerprint,region`. Also add a suppression predicate for transient DB/cache flags.

Lina Zhou: I'll add telemetry for `pages_per_fingerprint` and `median_time_between_pages`. That will help pick `paged_until`. Target: telemetry PR by Wed.

Maya Ortiz: I'll own the alert PR. Plan: open infra/alerts/transformer.yml, stage canary namespace for 48h, then gradual rollout. PR will include rollback plan and a smoke test. Target: PR by Tue EOD.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: Alert PRs must include `rollback_plan` and `test_vector`.

Diego Ramos: For suppression, propose: if transient errors >= 70% in last 10m then suppress pages for that fingerprint for N minutes. Start N=120.

Priya Rao: Also add `paged_until` annotation and `backoff: exponential(1m,2,6)`. Ensure we do not dedupe across `region` so regional incidents still page.

Samir Patel: Good call. Add a safety: any alert with `impact=high` bypasses suppression for first 5m so ops sees critical outages.

Maya Ortiz: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/847 (draft). Contains rollback: revert commit, test_vector via pushgateway. Will not merge until telemetry shows expected reduction in duplicates in staging.

Lina Zhou: Telemetry PR created: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/156. Added Grafana panel and a panel link in PR description.

Priya Rao: Action items (RDW-4637):
- Maya Ortiz: PR for rule change + rollout (target Tue EOD)
- Lina Zhou: Telemetry metrics + dashboard (target Wed)
- Samir Patel: Validate suppression predicate, produce 24/72h paging snapshots after canary (target: after canary)
- Diego Ramos: Update runbook with `how to check`, `how to silence`, and `rollback` (target Fri)

Maya Ortiz: Canary started. Will post 24h snapshot in this thread.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: Follow-up owners must update the Jira ticket or set new ETAs within 7 days.

Samir Patel: Early canary numbers: duplicate pages down ~55% in first 6h. Continuing monitor.

Priya Rao: Great. Reconvene in 7 days to close action items. If we see missed signals, roll back immediately and notify #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
